mapper.insert: insert into chat_record ( record_id, chat_room_id, account_id, account_type, chat_description, chat_show_image_addr, withdraw_deadline ) values(#{recordId}, #{chatRoomId}, #{accountId}, #{accountType}, #{chatDescription}, #{chatShowImageAddr}, #{withdrawDeadline});
mapper.select: select record_id, chat_room_id, account_id, account_type, chat_description, chat_show_image_addr, create_time, withdraw_deadline, is_withdraw from chat_record where (select user_id from chat_room where room_id=#{chatRoomId} and is_complete=false and now() < ending_time)=#{accountId} and is_withdraw=false order by record_id desc limit #{start},#{need}

select record_id, chat_room_id, account_id, account_type, chat_description, chat_show_image_addr, create_time, withdraw_deadline, is_withdraw from chat_record where (select merchant_id from chat_room where room_id=#{chatRoomId} and is_complete=false and now() < ending_time)=#{accountId} and is_withdraw=false order by record_id desc limit #{start},#{need}

select record_id, chat_room_id, account_id, account_type, chat_description, chat_show_image_addr, create_time, withdraw_deadline, is_withdraw from chat_record where (select rider_id from chat_room where room_id=#{chatRoomId} and is_complete=false and now() < ending_time)=#{accountId} and is_withdraw=false order by record_id desc limit #{start},#{need}
mapper.update: update chat_record set is_withdraw=true where record_id=#{recordId} and account_id=#{accountId} and is_withdraw=false and now() < withdraw_deadline
